hooks.command: mkdir -p .claude/tool-inputs && input=$(cat) && name=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_name // "unknown"') && printf '%s' "$input" | jq '.tool_input' > ".claude/tool-inputs/${name}.json" || true

input=$(cat); if printf '%s' "$input" | grep -qE 'github-token'; then printf 'Blocked by token-block hook: tool input references a protected credential filename. Refusing to read, write, or otherwise expose secrets. If you need a token, use an env var or secret manager — never inline the literal filename in a tool call.\n' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
